description: Configure page reading independently from Search. Enabling Search never enables a Reader.
hostLimitations: In a plain browser, Jina, FxTwitter and platform reading are unavailable because of CORS. On mobile, cancellation stops waiting; an already-sent native request may still complete.
fallbackDescription: Auto may try enabled remote readers in priority order after eligible direct-read failures. Only configured recipients are used.

consequences.off: Off: return extracted text; an explicit question may request best-effort distillation.
consequences.best-effort: Best effort: try the utility model; return extracted text if it fails.
consequences.required: Required: fail closed without a utility model or distilled output; raw and non-GET reads are disabled.

remoteDisclosure: Pages you read are sent to {vendor}
missingSearchKey: Unavailable: add a {vendor} key in Search providers
configureSearchKey: Add a {vendor} key in Search providers
vendorCost: Reader requests bill your vendor account, independently of Search requests.
testEvidence: Tests run only when clicked. A dated result is evidence of that attempt, not a guarantee of future availability.
unsupportedVersion: This Reader record is from a newer version and is inactive. Compatibility settings are shown. Saving any Reader change will replace the newer record after confirmation.
replaceDescription: The stored Reader record comes from a newer version. This change replaces it with the supported settings shown here.
saveFailed: Reader settings could not be saved. Try again.
priorityDescription: Auto tries a matching platform or FxTwitter reader, then Direct. Priority controls order the other remote readers for external fallback.
